Usage
When to reach for it.
One screen, one main action: Continue, Pay, Apply filters, Call. Primary = Action, Secondary = Normal.
Two actions at most. A third action goes into the content or an Action sheet (7.10).
Summary when money is involved: show the total next to the action.
Never together with Bottom navigation (6.7) on the same screen — the bar replaces it on task screens (checkout, forms, filters).
Keep Home indicator space on for iOS. Turn it off only when the container sits inside a Bottom sheet that already has its own safe area.
